items.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But neither was Sun Ra, he was just... people would say “what? what kind of outer space music is that?”

ctx.x: Billy Taylor refused to announce it. They had to get somebody else that was unknown to announce it. We were totally regarded with no great esteem. But neither was Sun Ra, he was just... people would say “what? what kind of outer space music is that?”
